goal: SQL review: injection in dynamic SQL, missing indexes, locking and destructive statements.
use: SQL review: injection in dynamic SQL, missing indexes, locking and destructive statements. Use when asked to review SQL scripts, queries or migrations.

steps.note: List the statements. Queries, updates, deletes and migrations.
Check dynamic SQL. Flag statements built with string concatenation.
Check indexes. Flag filters and joins on unindexed columns.
Check locks. Flag long transactions and updates without batching.
Check destructive statements. Flag deletes or drops with no where clause or backup.
